howMorphologyEntersSearch.measurement: lib/skill6/engines/morphology.ts readShape. Compact, branching, vertical, and quality are computed after a placement already passed geometric validation. They do not accept a contact.
howMorphologyEntersSearch.rule: aggregateCoverage with profile 2 and organization set to the requested preset. scoreOrganizationV2 biases each accepted pose. Four sequential rule sets share that same preset; later sets tabu the earlier first guest. rankReadings then keeps the highest preset score. The runner stores one cluster.
howMorphologyEntersSearch.graph: Plan order changes with the preset: compact tries wide fan, widening, paired, then chain; branching tries paired, widening, wide, then chain. Edge weights penalize span for compact and extra children for branching. finish ranks the realized plans by the same preset score. The runner stores one cluster.
howMorphologyEntersSearch.wfc: preference() weights the collapse: compact favors area and short translations; branching favors a new direction and a host that already has a child. The random stream also shifts with the preset name. Up to six solutions are ranked by the preset score. The runner stores one cluster.
howMorphologyEntersSearch.evolutionary: Historical. Fitness during evolution is morphologyScore. It is not an active engine.

diagnostics.note: Read-only diagnosis of eight stored clusters. Experiment files and meshes were not modified. Views are renders of stored meshes and stored poses.

Graph Branching at seven tiles, all four plans, and the reproduced Rule Branching four-tile failure with stage penetrations. Ranking, thresholds, and refinement settings were not changed. Overnight meshes were not rewritten.

Both six-tile Graph plans pass as six-tile geometry and remain incomplete seven-tile attempts. Their budget share ended at 6. Validated clusters also have tiles-only and raw-union crossings that refinement clears. Rule Branching 4 keeps two refined crossings, max 0.0354. The chain was not rewritten.

Widening and wide fan each received 420 tests. Both place a validated seven-tile assembly that is not the stored chain. The two remaining Rule crossings sit on the compressed-sequential pair and already exist in the raw union. Default budgets and refinement are unchanged.

The two seven-tile Graph alternatives are a separate collection. A local seam split clears the 0.0354 Rule crossing with a 0.0022 move and does not clear the 0.0256 crossing. The result is not validated. The overnight chain, the 210-test share, and refinement settings are unchanged.

Rule Compact reaches a validated seven-tile cluster when the backtrack cap is 16 and the evaluation allowance is 240 per tile. Branching stays at five tiles at 16 and at 24. The overnight six-of-seven result and the default caps are unchanged.

system01.note: First computational clustering approach. Remains independently demonstrable for the research presentation. Rule-Based, Graph-Based, WFC, Compact, Branching, geometry, assembly, the interface, and the stored experiments stay as written.

system02.note: Does not use the Skill 6 lab or the Skill 6 assembly pipeline. Skill 6 does not use its interface. When it exists, record which methods were retained, adapted, or replaced. Do not rewrite System 01 results.

recommendedExperiment.doNot: Do not remove Compact or Branching. Do not change the three engines' active presets. Do not overwrite clustering-overnight-v1.
recommendedExperiment.scope: Five tiles only. Rule, Graph, and WFC. Seed 101. Root open-hall. 120 tests per tile. Same checked pool and the same geometric thresholds.
recommendedExperiment.method: Keep every distinct complete placement the current search already produces, instead of discarding all but the preset winner. Measure compact, branching, vertical, connectivity, and geometricDiversity afterward. Record the non-dominated set and label it measured.
recommendedExperiment.stopIf: If each engine returns only one geometry, the presets are still the source of variation and they stay.
